items.headline: $XTEN Airdrop Checker Live — Sign by Dec 31
items.summary: Extended opened its $XTEN allocation checker with a Dec. 31 signing deadline. Unclaimed allocations go to the Ecosystem Fund; token launch date still TBA.

items.headline: $ACX Bridge Across Hit by Domain Hijack
items.summary: Crosschain protocol Across restored systems after attackers seized its domain via a Namecheap social-engineering attack. Users were urged to avoid the app during the incident.

items.headline: $PYTH Taps NYSE for Real-Time Stock Data
items.summary: $PYTH Network added real-time NYSE stock and ETF data to its marketplace, covering five NYSE Group exchanges — a big push into tokenized-equity oracles.

items.headline: $VAR Coming: Variational Opens Omni to All
items.summary: Variational ended its Omni beta and dropped the invite-code gate, opening the perp DEX to everyone ahead of its $VAR token launch slated for Q4 2026.

items.headline: $STX Tests Post-Quantum Signatures on Mainnet
items.summary: Stacks executed a mainnet $sBTC vault withdrawal using a Lamport one-time signature, an early post-quantum security test for the Bitcoin L2 ecosystem.
